name: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig breeds - Establishment of Pig Semen Collection and Processing Lab
benefit:
> **Establishment of Semen Processing Laboratory:** 

- Assistance is provided for setting up a semen processing laboratory at government pig farms to produce high-quality liquid boar semen for artificial insemination.
> **Financial Assistance for Laboratory Setup:** 

- One-time grants-in-aid of up to ₹1.5 crore are provided as the Central share for the construction of semen laboratories an
_eligibility_text:
**Eligible Entity:**

1. State Livestock Agencies,
1. Animal Husbandry Department, State Government
